source_documents.title: Enhancement of the Excited-state Intramolecular Proton Transfer Process to Produce All-powerful DSE Molecules for Bridging the Gap Between ACQ and AIE

reference_evidence_units.quote: Even in methanol, ITP1 exhibits clear enol/keto PL efficiency
reference_evidence_units.subject: ITP1
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Dilute methanol, emission spectra and absolute quantum yield.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Two bands at 395 and 525 nm have reported yields of 2 and 5 percent; authors assign enol and keto emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Band assignment supports the proposed ESIPT interpretation but is not ultrafast proton-transfer kinetics.

reference_evidence_units.quote: solvate ITP1 and partially restrict the ESIPT
reference_evidence_units.subject: ITP1
reference_evidence_units.statement: Methanol hydrogen bonding is proposed to compete with intramolecular proton transfer and lower efficiency.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is specific solvent interaction; not a host-guest complex by itself.

reference_evidence_units.quote: 35 due to the enhancement of ESIPTthat restricts the TICT.
reference_evidence_units.subject: ITP1 versus DF1
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Benzene; quantum yields and lifetimes used for rate estimates.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors interpret an approximately 35-fold lower nonradiative rate than DF1 with near-unchanged radiative rate as ESIPT suppressing TICT.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: DF1 is a different scaffold; causal attribution is an interpretation of a compound comparison rather than a direct TICT-state measurement.

reference_evidence_units.subject: ITP1 and DF1
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Ground-state HOMO atomic-contribution comparison, with tabulated coefficients in embedded SI.
reference_evidence_units.statement: A smaller N10/O orbital-contribution difference motivates the proposed stronger intramolecular proton-transfer tendency in ITP1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A ground-state orbital proxy does not demonstrate an excited-state proton-transfer rate.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The PL efficiency of ITP1 was slightly lower
reference_evidence_units.subject: ITP1 versus DF1 solid
reference_evidence_units.statement: ITP1 has 11 percent yield versus DF1 26 percent; ITP1 knr is about three times higher while kr remains similar.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Solution improvement does not imply improved solid-state emission. Do not merge the two environments.

reference_evidence_units.quote: equivalent of two different imidazole isomers
reference_evidence_units.subject: ITP1 crystal
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Single-crystal packing, Fig. 3 and embedded Fig. S1.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source describes equal 3H-imi/1H-imi forms with intermolecular H bonds and close pi contacts, interpreted as H-aggregate packing that lowers emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The crystal isomer mixture does not certify the inherited SMILES tautomer; diagram-to-graph verification is deferred.

reference_evidence_units.quote: bonding interactions restricting the rotation of ring D
reference_evidence_units.subject: ITP1/DF1 structural comparison
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crystal analysis of intramolecular H bonds.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors identify restricted phenyl-ring rotation as a structural factor retained in ITP1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A structural restriction is not a measured dynamical rate; the specific ITP5 substitution experiment is only comparative.

reference_evidence_units.quote: red-shifted emission was observed for ITP1 and ITP2
reference_evidence_units.subject: ITP1 and ITP2
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Approximately 1000 equivalents Et3N in DMF or CH3CN.
reference_evidence_units.statement: ITP1 red-shifts under base addition, unlike phenolate-forming ITP3/ITP4/ITP6. Authors propose preserved intramolecular H bonding and new intermolecular H bonding.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The authors' molecular association is tentative and must not be replaced by the ITP4 deprotonation interpretation.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Source assigns a restricting role to intramolecular hydrogen bonding, with proxy-level support.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Crystal packing helps explain why solid ITP1 is less efficient despite the solution benefit.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source invokes suppression of a competing TICT loss channel, not direct bright TICT emission.

reference_mechanisms.label: ESIPT_PT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Dual enol/keto emission and solvent/comparator analysis underpin the source's ESIPT interpretation.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Retain specifically the author's H-aggregate/quenching interpretation; no excimer is established.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Rate estimates distinguish nearly unchanged kr and environment-dependent knr.
